name: tapered-strand
why: A tapered pipe against the frustum formula along a bent path: a 6 mm tube scaled to 0.25 along 30 mm of run, a 10 mm quarter bend and 30 mm of run is pi * 9 * 75.708 * (1 + 0.25 + 0.0625) / 3 = 936.509 mm3, which holds because the scale is linear in length along the whole spine and the section stays centred on it. The exact B-rep reads 936.5089 through BRepGProp. A law that followed each edge's own parameter would have read differently, since the arc and runs differ in length.
